text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I'm relaxing at an outdoor cafe...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... Sky?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: What's up, Flower? You're mumbling.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, do we... stand out?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huh? No way.

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Look, look! They're so cute! ♪ They
must be from
Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Woman B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah. They must be on break! I'm
shocked
they know about this place.
What mature girls
they are! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... I think we should go.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Why? Our drinks haven't even come yet.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But... everyone around us is staring...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Weren't you the one who kept saying
you wanted
to come here?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Something about it being all "chic" and

"grown-up"?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I did, but... I don't know if I was ready
for this
place yet.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Flower, take a look at that customer
over there.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Over there?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
See how calm they are? They're not put
off by
how fancy this place is.
choice_data_list_en: (I'm being stared at for some reason...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's because they're an adult...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well then, do you know what makes
someone an
adult?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's having the confidence to not be
bothered by
things like this. It's all
about confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Confidence!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep! You wanted to be more mature,
right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Then you gotta act like it! Start adulting!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: A-adulting? Uhhh...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ooh... Yeah, that's it. Very mature. I'm
sure our
friend over there would
agree—wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: What? Really?
choice_data_list: すごくオトナっぽいよ
choice_data_list_en: It looks very mature on you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
See, what did I tell ya? You're becoming
more
mature already!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I see. I'm... mature. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, so just relax already. Feel the nice
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No! I told you already, I have training
soon, so I
can't stay for too long!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah? ...I think I've given you too
much
confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: S-Sky?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What? I was wrong? Okay, then try
giving us a
smile.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that'll make you look more
mature.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Really? Okay...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: How's this? Heehee... ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ooh, yeah! Sooo cute! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sky... Are you... making fun of me?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Whaaaat? Nooo!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, our drinks are coming! Make sure
you look
mature!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, ah!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Wait, Skyyy!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nyahaha! ☆
